title: Basic 7 · Sum two images
summary: Arithmetic a+b on two test images via arith.binop with op=add. The atomic class-averaging operation.

steps.title: Try image addition
steps.body: Add two images pixel-by-pixel. In cryo-EM this is the atomic operation of **class averaging** — aligning many particle images and summing them to raise S/N. Here we add two different test images and watch the two patterns combine.

steps.title: Run the graph to check
steps.body: Press ▶ Run graph so `data.clock` shows its image before we add the next input.

steps.title: Drop the Checker image
steps.body: From Palette (Data), drag **Test · Checkerboard** (`data.checker`) — a 128×128 checkerboard.

steps.title: Run the graph to check
steps.body: Press ▶ Run graph so `data.checker` now also has a preview — you can see both source images before combining them.

steps.title: Drop the Arithmetic node
steps.body: From the Arithmetic category, drag **Arithmetic · a ∘ b** (`arith.binop`). It's a general 2-input op whose `op` dropdown selects add / sub / mul / div. Default is `add`, which is what we want here.

steps.title: Wire Clock → a
steps.body: Drag from Clock's `image` output to Arithmetic's `a` input. Clock becomes the left operand.

steps.title: Wire Checker → b
steps.body: Drag from Checkerboard's `image` output to Arithmetic's `b` input. Checker becomes the right operand.

steps.title: Run the graph
steps.body: Press ▶ Run graph. Clock + Checker is emitted — the clock face overlaid with the checkerboard pattern, with both intensities superimposed.

steps.title: 🎉 Done
steps.body: To add inputs with mismatched scales (e.g. compute a class average), use `arith.calc` with a formula like `P1*0.5 + P2*0.5` for coefficient-weighted summation. Next, **Basic 8 · Subtract two images** takes the difference of the same pair to highlight what differs.
